rust_summary: An opt-in ordinary server chat hook with cancellation, rewriting, and UUID recipient selection.
doc_summary: Set native_server_chat_listened to true to receive native_server_chat(player, name, message, recipients, canceled). Recipients defaults to All; Only lists the UUIDs allowed to receive the line, including its sender. Changed text is sent unsigned, and is limited to 256 UTF-16 units. Require hooks @API:server_chat@ or higher.
